title: Fire and Ice Background
content: A background for the Bakshi / Frazetta film"Fire and Ice"(1983), cel vinyl and acrylic paint.Tom Kinkade and I tried to translate Frazetta's style of muscular, twisting forms into animation backgrounds.We added depth and atmosphere using airbrushes. To make a soft edge on the rays of light, you could set up a floating straight stencil. Our Paasche airbrushes were powered first by loud compressors and then oxygen tanks.
